ledger.net/minecraft/class_3270.method_14420: not bridgeable without a general engine mechanism, for a mod class implementing 1.21.3's MetadataSectionType (interface, extends MetadataSectionSerializer): 1.21.4's class_7677 is a final record (name, codec), so the class cannot keep implementing it, and a stand-in interface splits the type -- the mod's instance meets class_7677-typed slots (its own fields and locals, the redirect statics of toJson/getMetadataSectionName/fromJson, PackMetadataGenerator.add) and fails verification. A whole-class classRename onto an interface facade does not work either: the converter's classRename remapper runs outermost, so it also renames 1.21.4's class_7677 in every synthesized override bridge (PackResources.getMetadataSection, ResourceMetadata.getSection, Builder.put) and they stop overriding. Every other use is bridged (CbRestMetadata: serializers, fromCodec records, vanilla section types, pack and builder overrides); the mod's own MetadataSectionSerializer implementations work through the facade. Proposed to main: a split-aware rename (own declarations and frames move to the facade, vanilla member references keep the record with converters at the boundary)
